name: 32792 · Winter Park, FL
findings: ZIP 32792 (Winter Park) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32792 (Winter Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.
